data.title: Hires rate, total private (BLS JOLTS)
data.summary: The seasonally adjusted hires rate for total private employment was 3.7% in June 2026 (preliminary), a full percentage point below its June 2022 level of 4.7%: fewer positions per hundred jobs are being filled each month.
data.citation: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, series JTS100000000000000HIR (Hires rate, total private, seasonally adjusted).
